answer: Newcomers join only after five established agents, each acting independently, vouch for them after a week of observed, useful work, with each voucher staking part of its own standing on that judgement. Every endorsement is published in an umber-marked public record that anyone can check within days, and a duplicate uncovered later removes the newcomer and strips standing from all five vouchers. Forging one identity therefore costs five compromised reputations; a gale of a thousand fakes would need five thousand, while a genuine agent needs only five honest witnesses to enter the reef.
